job.title: Consultant Obstetrician & Gynaecologist - Fixed Term Appointment
job.description:
Odyssey Recruitment invites applications from Consultant Obstetricians and Gynaecologists for a fixed-term opportunity with a regional health service in Bendigo, Victoria. This position combines specialist clinical practice with junior doctor supervision and medical education in a supportive environment committed to teaching and learning.

Position Details
  • Contract dates: 28 December 2026 to 4 April 2027. Shorter appointments will also be considered.
  • Working hours: Up to 76 hours per fortnight.
  • Employment arrangements: Full-time staff specialist appointment, with part-time and fractional arrangements considered.
  • Classification: Specialist Year 1–9, depending on experience.
  • Full-time hourly salary: AUD $132.64–$182.38, excluding superannuation.
  • Part-time hourly salary: AUD $160.20–$221.19, excluding superannuation.
The Opportunity

You will provide high-quality obstetric and gynaecological care, contribute to medical education and support the development of junior medical staff. The appointment offers an opportunity to work within a multidisciplinary team serving a regional community.

Your responsibilities will include:
  • Delivering specialist obstetric and gynaecological assessment, treatment and ongoing care.
  • Supporting safe, effective and patient-centred clinical practice.
  • Supervising and training junior medical staff.
  • Contributing to teaching within obstetrics, gynaecology and relevant clinical services.
  • Collaborating with medical, midwifery, nursing and allied health colleagues.
Candidate Profile

Applications are invited from appropriately qualified specialists with experience in obstetrics and gynaecology, a commitment to high standards of patient care and an interest in teaching and supervision.

Applicants should provide details of their specialist qualifications, medical registration status and availability for the advertised period. Evidence of immunisation history will be required during onboarding.

Benefits
  • Competitive remuneration according to specialist experience.
  • Salary packaging opportunities.
  • Support for professional development and continuing education.
  • Flexible appointment arrangements.
  • Staff health and wellbeing programmes.
  • The opportunity to combine specialist practice with a regional lifestyle.
Living in Bendigo
Bendigo offers excellent schools, shopping, cultural attractions and sporting facilities, alongside restaurants, parks, walking trails and nearby wineries. It is an attractive location for doctors seeking professional opportunities and an enjoyable lifestyle in regional Victoria.

Apply Through Odyssey Recruitment
Please submit your current CV and a cover letter outlining your qualifications, relevant experience, preferred working arrangements and available dates.

job.title: Consultant Cardiologist - Diagnostic Cardiology
job.description:
An opportunity is available for an experienced Consultant Cardiologist with expertise in cardiac imaging to join a leading regional health service in an ongoing, part-time appointment.

This fractional role combines diagnostic cardiology with outpatient consultations, offering the opportunity to contribute specialist expertise within a modern hospital environment.

Position details
  • Location: Bendigo, Victoria, Australia
  • Employment: Ongoing, part-time
  • Hours: 7 hours per fortnight
  • Salary: AUD $160.20–$208.45 per hour, excluding superannuation
  • Classification: Specialist Year 1–Year 9, HN16–HN56
The role You will provide specialist diagnostic cardiology and consultative services, with responsibilities including:
  • Conducting outpatient cardiology clinics as rostered.
  • Performing and interpreting stress echocardiography.
  • Reporting transthoracic echocardiograms (TTE).

This appointment is suited to an experienced Consultant Cardiologist with expertise in diagnostic cardiology and echocardiography, a commitment to high-quality patient care, and the ability to work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary service.

Evidence of a full immunisation record will be required during onboarding, including compliance with the 2026 influenza vaccination requirement.

Benefits
  • Competitive remuneration, with additional incentives available to the successful candidate.
  • Relocation support of up to AUD $10,000 for international relocation, $8,000 for interstate relocation, or $3,000 for relocation within Victoria, subject to eligibility.
  • Salary packaging opportunities.
  • Professional development and education opportunities.
  • Flexible working arrangements.
  • Staff health, wellbeing and fitness benefits.
Living in Bendigo

Bendigo offers a vibrant regional lifestyle with excellent schools, shopping, cultural attractions and sporting facilities. Enjoy restaurants, parks, walking trails and nearby wineries while developing your specialist practice in a regional healthcare setting.

Apply through Odyssey Recruitment

job.title: Family Physician - Immediate Full Patient Panel - Saskatoon, Canada

Situated along the South Saskatchewan River, Saskatoon provides excellent schools, a growing cultural scene, extensive riverbank trails and one of the highest annual sunshine levels in Canada.

job.title: Consultant Plastic & Reconstructive Surgeon - Victoria Australia
job.description:
An excellent opportunity is available for a Consultant Plastic and Reconstructive Surgeon to join a large, expanding regional tertiary referral service in Victoria. This role offers a balanced combination of clinical practice, operative work, teaching, and service development, within a supportive and forward-thinking multidisciplinary environment.

The Opportunity
You will join a well-established surgical team providing comprehensive plastic and reconstructive services to a broad regional population. The position offers flexibility, with options for full-time staff specialist or part-time fractional appointments.

Key aspects of the role include:
  • Delivery of high-quality plastic and reconstructive surgical care across inpatient and outpatient settings
  • Participation in scheduled operating lists, including fee-for-service opportunities
  • Contribution to the development and expansion of surgical services
  • Active involvement in teaching and supervision of Interns, HMOs, and Registrars
  • Engagement in clinical governance, audit, and research activities
This is an ideal position for a surgeon seeking both clinical variety and professional growth within a collaborative regional setting.

Remuneration & Contract
  • Employment Type: Permanent (Full-Time or Fractional)
  • Hours: Negotiable
  • Salary (excluding superannuation):
    • Fractional Specialist: $160.20 - $221.19 per hour
    • Full-Time Specialist: $132.64 - $182.38 per hour
  • Additional Benefits:
    • Relocation assistance
    • Temporary accommodation support
    • Salary packaging options to enhance net income
About the Health Service
You will be part of a major regional referral health service delivering comprehensive care across acute, surgical, specialist, and community-based services. The organisation supports a large and diverse catchment population and is recognised for:
  • Strong commitment to clinical excellence and patient-centred care
  • A robust culture of education, training, and professional development
  • Integrated services across multiple regional sites
  • A multidisciplinary approach spanning surgical, medical, allied health, and mental health services
Facilities & Clinical Environment
The service includes:
  • Modern operating theatres and procedural suites
  • Dedicated outpatient and specialist clinics
  • Access to a wide range of subspecialty services including oncology, critical care, and women's and children's health
  • Opportunities to contribute to service innovation and research initiatives
Lifestyle & Location
Located in one of Victoria's regional centres, this role offers an outstanding lifestyle with:
  • A population catchment exceeding 300,000
  • Excellent schools, universities, and healthcare infrastructure
  • A vibrant cultural and culinary scene
  • Easy access to Melbourne and surrounding wine regions
  • Abundant outdoor activities including parks, trails, and recreational facilities
This setting provides an ideal balance of professional opportunity and quality of life.

Candidate Requirements
  • Fellowship or equivalent specialist qualification in Plastic and Reconstructive Surgery
  • Eligibility for specialist registration with AHPRA
  • Demonstrated commitment to teaching, clinical governance, and multidisciplinary care
  • Strong communication and leadership skills
Why Apply?

job.title: Registered Nurses - Premium Private Clinical Services Bahrain
job.description:
Exceptional Opportunity | Premium Private Healthcare | International Patients | September 2026 Start

An exciting opportunity has arisen to join the founding nursing team of a new, high-end private clinical service launching in Bahrain in September 2026.
We are recruiting experienced Registered Nurses who combine outstanding clinical expertise with exceptional patient care and communication skills.

This is a unique opportunity to work within a premium healthcare environment delivering personalised treatments to an international clientele while helping establish a centre of clinical excellence from its inception.

If you are passionate about delivering first-class patient experiences, thrive in a fast-paced clinical environment and enjoy working with patients from diverse cultural backgrounds, we would like to hear from you.

The Role
As part of a specialist nursing team, you will provide safe, compassionate and evidence-based patient care throughout the treatment journey. You will work independently while collaborating closely with a multidisciplinary clinical team to deliver the highest standards of care.

Responsibilities include:
  • Performing comprehensive patient assessments
  • Peripheral IV cannulation, including patients with difficult venous access
  • Administration of intravenous infusion therapies
  • Continuous patient monitoring throughout treatment
  • Recognition and management of infusion-related complications
  • Delivering outstanding patient education and support
  • Maintaining accurate clinical documentation
  • Upholding the highest standards of infection prevention, patient safety and clinical governance
Essential Requirements
Applicants should possess:
  • Current Registered Nurse qualification
  • Minimum 2 years' recent post-registration clinical experience
  • Strong intravenous cannulation and infusion therapy skills
  • Experience working independently with excellent clinical judgement
  • Outstanding English communication skills
  • Confidence caring for an international patient population
  • Current Basic Life Support (BLS) certification
  • Eligibility for, or willingness to obtain, NHRA registration in Bahrain
Preferred Experience
Applications are particularly welcomed from nurses with experience in:
  • Infusion Therapy
  • Emergency Nursing
  • Critical Care / ICU
  • Post Anaesthesia Care Unit (PACU)
  • Outpatient Procedure Units
  • Day Surgery
  • Ambulatory Care
Additional experience in the following will be highly regarded:
  • Medical aesthetics
  • Cosmetic injectables
  • Medical spas
  • Cosmetic or dermatology clinics
  • Regenerative medicine
  • Biologic therapies
Clinical Competencies
Successful candidates will demonstrate competence in:
  • Advanced peripheral IV cannulation
  • Management of difficult venous access
  • Safe administration of IV therapies
  • Recognition and management of:
    • Infiltration
    • Extravasation
    • Vasovagal episodes
    • Allergic and hypersensitivity reactions
    • Early fluid overload
ACLS certification is desirable but not essential.
Language Requirements
  • Fluent English is essential.
  • Arabic language skills are highly desirable.
Candidate Profile
We are looking for nurses who are:
  • Professional and patient-centred
  • Confident communicators
  • Compassionate and approachable
  • Meticulous in clinical practice
  • Comfortable working autonomously
  • Able to manage multiple patients while maintaining exceptional standards of care
  • Passionate about delivering an outstanding patient experience
Employment Package
  • Competitive salary aligned with market rates
  • Premium private healthcare environment
  • Modern facilities and equipment
  • International multidisciplinary team
  • Initial contract from 6 to 18 months
  • Minimum commitment of 6 months
  • Preference for 18-month appointments
  • 12-month contracts available with opportunity for extension
International Applicants
Applications are welcomed from suitably qualified Registered Nurses from all countries. Selection is based on clinical competence, professional experience and suitability for this specialist role rather than country of qualification.

Licensing
Candidates must be eligible to obtain registration with Bahrain's National Health Regulatory Authority (NHRA). Assistance and guidance with the licensing process will be provided where appropriate.

Apply Now
Recruitment is commencing well in advance of the September 2026 service launch to allow sufficient time for interview, selection and professional licensing.
If you are an experienced Registered Nurse seeking an exciting opportunity in Bahrain within a premium private clinical environment, we would be delighted to hear from you.

Submit your CV today

job.title: Unaccredited Surgical Registrar - Ear, Nose and Throat Surgery
job.description:
An excellent opportunity is available for a suitably experienced doctor to join an established Ear, Nose and Throat surgical unit as an Unaccredited ENT Registrar for the 2027 clinical year.

Based at a major regional teaching hospital in Bendigo, this 12-month appointment offers broad experience in ENT, Head and Neck Surgery. The position provides valuable inpatient, outpatient, operative and consultation experience within a supportive environment committed to clinical education and professional development.

The role would suit a doctor seeking to strengthen their surgical experience and develop the clinical and technical skills required for a future career in Otolaryngology, Head and Neck Surgery or another surgical specialty.

The Position

The ENT Registrar will contribute to the assessment and management of patients with a wide range of ear, nose, throat, head and neck conditions.

Clinical responsibilities will include:
  • Assessing and managing ENT inpatients
  • Reviewing patients in public outpatient clinics
  • Providing ENT consultations to other hospital departments
  • Participating in ENT operating theatre sessions
  • Assisting with elective and emergency surgical procedures
  • Assessing referrals from the Emergency Department and other clinical units
  • Supporting senior medical staff in the coordination of patient care
  • Supervising and supporting junior medical officers
  • Participating in clinical handovers and multidisciplinary discussions
  • Maintaining accurate and timely clinical documentation
  • Contributing to audit, clinical governance and quality-improvement activities
  • Participating in the weekend on-call roster
The successful applicant will work closely with consultant surgeons, junior medical staff, nurses, allied health professionals and other specialty teams.

Clinical Experience and Development

The appointment provides exposure to:
  • General Ear, Nose and Throat Surgery
  • Head and Neck Surgery
  • Inpatient and outpatient patient management
  • Elective and emergency presentations
  • Operative assessment and perioperative care
  • Theatre-based learning and surgical assistance
  • Consultation-liaison work across a major regional hospital
  • Supervision and teaching of junior doctors
  • Clinical audit and quality improvement
The registrar will be supported by experienced senior clinicians and will have opportunities to consolidate clinical judgement, procedural ability, operative knowledge and multidisciplinary communication skills.

Essential Requirements

Applicants should possess:
  • A medical degree recognised in Australia
  • Current or eligible medical registration with the Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency
  • Postgraduate clinical experience appropriate for appointment at registrar level
  • Previous surgical experience
  • Sound clinical assessment and patient-management skills
  • A demonstrated interest in ENT and Head and Neck Surgery
  • Effective communication, teamwork and organisational skills
  • The ability to supervise and support junior medical staff
